d:
Enjoy this classic romantic Hindi song 'Ek Baat Poochhta Hoon' from movie 'Banarasi Thug' Starring Vijaya Chaudhary, I S Johar, Manoj Kumar & others.
Song: Ek Baat Puchta Hoon
Movie: Banarasi Thug (1963)
Singer: Mukesh, Usha Mangeshkar
Music: Iqbal Qureshi
Lyrics: Akhtar Warsi
Cast: Radha Krishan, Vijaya Chaudhary, I S Johar, Manoj Kumar
Director: Lekhraj Bakshi
